reviews.comment: Very different from other professors, lot of importance on creativity and uniqueness. He also allows a lot of freedom in your design and your choice of project. Talks a whole lot though, don't sleep. There are some readings & writings, as well as a daily 10 min sketch that can be hard to keep up with. Take Bob if you want something completely new.

Structured differently than other studios & stands out during roundtable. Emphasis on thinking, very conceptual class. Wants you to make your own decisions which gives freedom, but results in vague feedback and unclear instruction. Lots of hand drawings and the projects are harder but worth it. Unique class to take for my first sem but I enjoyed it

Bob is a great professor but he takes a unique aproach to teaching. The projects he gives are more more challenging but also more intersting than other first year projects. His class uses relevant software and he assigns an insane amout of drawing but you'll learn important skills for design. Also he will have you read philosphy and write poems.
